sections.title: Diagnosis Summary
sections.content:
**Primary Risk: The "Communication & Confidence" Business Analyst.**

Aakanksha, your profile is genuinely strong for the Ireland market: MSc Business Analytics (First-Class Honours, University of Limerick), Microsoft PL-300 and AZ-900 certified, Google Data Analytics certified, and 2+ years across Changepay (50,000+ transactional records, zero critical reporting errors, pricing and expansion influence), Three Ireland (80+ Salesforce cases resolved weekly, governance and data-quality improvements for a public sector client), and Indaco Jeans Factory (18% inventory discrepancy reduction). Your Resume & Experience Clarity score of 3.4 reflects credible, well-structured experience on the page.

However, your Answer Structure (2.8), Role-Specific Technical (2.8), and Behavioural Story (2.75) reveal a **Communication & Confidence Risk**: you know the work, but under interview pressure you may sound less decisive, less structured, and less personally owning than your resume and certifications suggest.

**The Mapping Rule Analysis:**

Technical Readiness (3.2) shows you can discuss BI tools, SQL, Salesforce, and analytics workflows, but Role-Specific Technical (2.8) indicates follow-ups may expose gaps—defending a specific DAX measure, explaining how you validated zero critical errors at Changepay, or walking through your Salesforce case-resolution workflow at Three Ireland. Answer Structure (2.8) means STAR flow can weaken when interrupted. Behavioural Story (2.75) suggests stakeholder stories (onshore/offshore alignment, vendor performance recommendations, business simulation team lead) may read as collaboration rather than *your* judgment and impact.

This "Certified and Capable, But Not Yet Commanding" persona is your primary hurdle: Ireland BA interviews will expect PL-300-level narrative confidence—you must sound like the analyst who influenced pricing decisions and fixed public-sector reporting risk, not someone who cleaned data behind the scenes.

sections.title: How This Risk Shows Up in Interviews
sections.content:
**Scenario A: The Resume Walkthrough (10–15m)**

**The Red Flag:** "Aakanksha, walk me through how you analysed 50,000+ Changepay transaction records and influenced pricing and expansion decisions. What did you find and what changed because of you?"

**Justification:** With Answer Structure at 2.8, you may describe dashboards and data cleaning without a crisp narrative: business problem → analysis method → insight → decision → outcome. Interviewers hear activity, not commercial impact.

---

**Scenario B: The Technical / BI Follow-Up (20–30m)**

**The Red Flag:** "You're PL-300 certified—explain one DAX measure you built for revenue-by-campus tracking. How did you handle data modelling, and how did you validate zero critical errors in executive reports?"

**Justification:** Role-Specific Technical 2.8 means certification may outpace live defence. Follow-ups on Power Query steps, data validation rules, or SQL logic behind failure-rate analysis can expose hesitation.

---

**Scenario C: The Behavioural + Stakeholder Probe (10–15m)**

**The Red Flag:** "Tell me about a time onshore and offshore teams disagreed on data, or a senior stakeholder challenged your analysis. What was the conflict, what did you recommend, and what changed?"

**Justification:** Behavioural Story 2.75 is your relative weak point. You have rich material (Three Ireland cross-team data discrepancies, Changepay vendor performance insights, business simulation leadership), but without rehearsed STAR structure the tension and your personal judgment get lost.

sections.title: Priority Fix Order

steps.title: STAR Story Bank + Opening Confidence
steps.content: Build 6 STAR stories: Changepay pricing/expansion insight, zero-error reporting validation, transaction failure pattern discovery, Three Ireland Salesforce governance fix, onshore/offshore data alignment, business simulation leadership (1st of 18 teams). Record each in 90 seconds. **Score Target:** Answer Structure 2.8 → 4.0, Behavioural Story 2.75 → 3.8

steps.title: PL-300 Defence Drill
steps.content: Prepare verbal walkthroughs: one Power BI data model, one DAX measure, one Power Query transformation, and your validation process for executive reports. Tie each to Changepay or Three Ireland. **Score Target:** Role-Specific Technical 2.8 → 4.2

steps.title: Domain Deep-Dives (Fintech + Retail + Telecom)
steps.content: Defend Changepay payment failure analysis, Indaco ERP/HubSpot reconciliation (18% discrepancy reduction), and Three Ireland Salesforce case patterns. Practice one SQL query and one stakeholder narrative aloud. **Score Target:** Technical Readiness 3.2 → 4.3, Resume Clarity 3.4 → 4.5

steps.title: The Pressure Test
steps.content: Full Ireland BA mock: Tell Me About Yourself → Changepay commercial walkthrough → Power BI/Salesforce technical → behavioural stakeholder conflict → MSc/PL-300/career pivot motivation. No notes, no trailing endings. **Score Target:** Overall Average → 4.5

sections.content: Complete each phase before moving to the next. Week 1 builds the confidence foundation everything else depends on.

sections.title: Resume-Anchored Technical Prep
sections.content:
**Experience: Changepay — 50,000+ Transaction Analysis & Pricing Influence**

**Interviewer Probe:** "What specific trends did you find in order and payment failures? How did leadership use your dashboards to change pricing or campus expansion?"

**Likely Struggle:** Mapping to Role-Specific Technical (2.8), you may say "I built Power BI dashboards" without naming metrics, failure definitions, campus/vendor comparisons, or the exact decision that changed.

**Prep Drill:** Document: (1) data sources and volume, (2) key metrics (failure rate, peak order times, revenue by campus/vendor), (3) one insight that changed a decision, (4) validation for zero critical errors. Practice: "I analysed 50k+ payment records, tracked failure rates by campus and vendor, surfaced that [Campus X / Vendor Y] drove [Z]% of failures—leadership used this to [pricing/expansion action]."

---

**Experience: Changepay — Zero Critical Errors in Executive Reports**

**Interviewer Probe:** "How exactly did you validate merchant and delivery data before reports reached senior stakeholders? What checks caught errors and what was your QA process?"

**Likely Struggle:** Claiming "zero critical errors" without describing validation steps, reconciliation rules, or escalation when vendor data was inconsistent.

**Prep Drill:** List: data sources, cleaning rules, cross-checks between vendor and campus datasets, sign-off process, and one example error you caught before it reached leadership.

---

**Experience: Three Ireland — 80+ Salesforce Cases Weekly & Governance**

**Interviewer Probe:** "Walk me through how you analyse and resolve Salesforce data cases for a public sector client. What patterns did you find in reporting trackers, and what process improvement did you propose?"

**Likely Struggle:** Describing "80+ cases weekly" without root cause categories, pattern detection method, or the specific governance fix you recommended.

**Prep Drill:** Write: case types, detection method (tracker analysis, Salesforce fields), stakeholder groups involved, proposed workflow change, and how data consistency improved for leadership reporting.

---

**Experience: Three Ireland — Onshore/Offshore Data Discrepancies**

**Interviewer Probe:** "What caused recurring delays between onshore and offshore teams, and what targeted fixes did you recommend?"

**Likely Struggle:** Generic "collaboration" without naming the discrepancy type, investigation steps, or measurable improvement in process consistency.

**Prep Drill:** STAR story: specific data mismatch → investigation method → stakeholder conversation → fix adopted → operational outcome.

---

**Experience: Indaco Jeans Factory — ERP & HubSpot Reconciliation (18% Reduction)**

**Interviewer Probe:** "How did you identify inventory discrepancies between ERP and HubSpot, and how did you measure the 18% reduction?"

**Likely Struggle:** Stating "built dashboards" without reconciliation logic, baseline discrepancy rate, or how production planning used the consolidated view.

**Prep Drill:** Define data sources, mismatch types, dashboard metrics, baseline vs. after measurement, and one operational decision supported by the reports.

sections.title: Interview Answer Construction Guidance
sections.content:
**Experience:** Influencing pricing and expansion decisions from Changepay transaction analysis.

**Baseline Answer (Score 2.8 — Communication & Confidence Weakness):**
"At Changepay I was a Junior Business Analyst. I worked with transaction and payment data. I built Power BI dashboards for leadership about revenue and orders. I found some trends and helped with pricing decisions. We had zero errors in reports and I validated merchant data."

**Fixed Answer (Score 4.5+ — Structured & Confident):**
"Changepay leadership lacked visibility into which campuses and vendors were underperforming—failed transactions were hurting student experience but weren't tracked systematically. (Situation) I needed to turn 50,000+ order and payment records into weekly decision-ready insight. (Task) I validated and cleaned merchant and delivery data across vendors and campus locations, built Power BI dashboards tracking transaction volumes, peak order times, and revenue by campus and vendor, and enforced a QA process that achieved zero critical errors before every executive report. (Action) The analysis showed [specific campus/vendor pattern], which directly informed pricing adjustments and expansion prioritisation for underperforming locations. (Result)"

**Justification:** The fixed version uses STAR, names *your* analysis and validation, ties dashboards to commercial decisions, and sounds PL-300-credible under follow-up.

sections.title: High-Risk Questions (The Landmines)
sections.content:
"Walk me through one DAX measure you built at Changepay—what business question did it answer and how did you validate it?" **(Risk: Role-Specific Technical 2.8)**

"How exactly did you achieve zero critical errors across all executive reports—what was your QA process?" **(Risk: Role-Specific Technical 2.8)**

"What recurring patterns did you find across Three Ireland reporting trackers, and what governance improvement did you propose?" **(Risk: Resume Clarity 3.4 — must defend live)**

"Tell me about resolving onshore/offshore data discrepancies—what was the conflict and what fix did you recommend?" **(Risk: Behavioural Story 2.75)**

"How did you measure the 18% inventory discrepancy reduction at Indaco—what was the baseline and reconciliation method?" **(Risk: Technical Readiness 3.2)**

"Tell me about a time you pushed back on a stakeholder's interpretation of operational data." **(Risk: Behavioural Story 2.75)**

"You led a team to 1st place in an 18-team business simulation—what was *your* decision that changed the outcome?" **(Risk: Answer Structure 2.8)**

"Why Business Analyst in Ireland after a Fashion Technology undergrad—how does your path connect?" **(Risk: Communication & Confidence)**

sections.content:
**Session 1: Tell Me About Yourself + Changepay Walkthrough**

**Focus:** 90-second intro (MSc UL First-Class + PL-300 + Changepay/Three Ireland arc) and two STAR stories with commercial metrics.

**Mentor Push:** Stop filler and rushed endings. Interrupt tool-listing—require Problem → Insight → Decision → Result for every Changepay claim.

---

**Session 2: Power BI, SQL & Salesforce Deep-Dive**

**Focus:** Campus transaction dashboards, revenue KPIs, validation for zero errors, Salesforce case resolution patterns, ERP/HubSpot reconciliation logic.

**Mentor Push:** Ask "Show me the logic" for DAX and SQL. If Aakanksha cites PL-300 without live explanation, assign one-page technical defence before Session 3.

---

**Session 3: Behavioural + Stakeholder Impact**

**Focus:** Onshore/offshore data alignment at Three Ireland, Changepay vendor performance influence, public sector client reporting pressure, simulation team leadership.

**Mentor Push:** Reject "we collaborated" answers. Demand: "What did *you* recommend? Who disagreed? What changed?"

---

**Session 4: Full Ireland BA Simulation**

**Focus:** Realistic hiring loop—commercial BA narrative, Power BI/SQL/Salesforce, behavioural, Fashion Technology → BA career pivot story.

**Mentor Push:** Simulate interruption and silence. Pass only if mock average ≥ 4.5/5.

sections.title: Expected Outcome
sections.content:
**Target Average Score: 4.5**

**Measurable Change:**

- Move from "I built Power BI dashboards" to "I modelled [tables/relationships], wrote [DAX measure] to track [KPI], validated with [QA process], and leadership used it to [pricing/expansion decision]."
- Move from "I resolved Salesforce cases" to a defended workflow: case types, pattern analysis, governance recommendation, and improved public-sector reporting reliability.
- The "After" Persona: A **confident PL-300-backed Business Analyst** who narrates commercial impact clearly, defends BI and Salesforce methodology under pressure, and owns stakeholder stories—not someone who hides behind certifications or team language.

sections.title: How to Use This Plan

candidateSteps.title: Complete Week 1 STAR bank before Session 1
candidateSteps.content: Six stories recorded on video (90 sec each). No Session 1 until Changepay pricing influence and Three Ireland governance stories are crisp without notes.

candidateSteps.title: PL-300 cheat sheet — one page per work example
candidateSteps.content: For Changepay and Three Ireland: data model sketch, one DAX measure, one validation rule. Rehearse aloud daily.

candidateSteps.title: Re-practice failed questions within 24 hours
candidateSteps.content: After each mock, fix hesitation on DAX, SQL joins, Salesforce workflows, or behavioural conflict questions immediately—confidence gaps compound.

candidateSteps.title: Do NOT mass-apply until Session 4 ≥ 4.5/5
candidateSteps.content: Answer Structure 2.8 and Behavioural 2.75 will lose offers despite strong credentials. Use mocks as gates.

mentorSteps.title: Coach delivery, not just content
mentorSteps.content: Aakanksha has strong material—push pace, eye contact, and decisive endings. Restart any answer that trails off without a Result.

mentorSteps.title: Test certification vs. live skill
mentorSteps.content: PL-300 should mean she can explain DAX and data modelling on the spot. Probe until live skill matches cert level.

mentorSteps.title: Written feedback: structure + ownership
mentorSteps.content: Track weekly movement on Answer Structure and Behavioural. Flag "we" language and unsubstantiated metrics.

mentorSteps.title: Reset expectations
mentorSteps.content: Passing Session 4 means interview-competitive, not guaranteed offers. Ireland BA market also tests domain fit and right-to-work—keep mocks realistic.

sections.content:
**Non-negotiable rule:**
If Session 4 score is <4.5/5, repeat Sessions 2–4 in Week 5. Do not mass-apply to Ireland BA roles until PL-300-level answers match live performance.

**Timeline:**
- Week 1: STAR story bank + video self-review
- Week 2: Sessions 1–2 (Walkthrough + Power BI/SQL/Salesforce deep-dive)
- Week 3: Session 3 (Behavioural + stakeholders)
- Week 4: Session 4 (Full simulation)
- Week 5: Buffer for repetition if needed

Start Week 1 today. Email your mentor when all six STAR recordings are complete.
